title: Jazzy Pillowy Tunisian Corn Arepa Calzone
description: Earthy, pillowy, indulgent Tunisian dish featuring corn arepa filled with mozzarella cheese, mirepoix-base, raw-friendly in a terracotta dish.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the ground cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate pan or griddle, cook the corn arepas until they are lightly browned and puffed, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Place a cooked arepa on a flat surface and spoon some of the mirepoix base onto the center of the arepa.
Place a slice of mozzarella cheese on top of the mirepoix base.
Fold the arepa in half to form a calzone and press the edges together to seal.
Place the calzone in the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the arepa is crispy.
Remove the calzone from the oven and let it cool for 2-3 minutes before serving.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
